# The CAD Pillar

> The CAD Pillar (thecadpillar.com) is a jewelry CAD design service for jewelry businesses: custom jewelers, bridal jewelers, retailers, brands, wholesalers and manufacturers. It turns a sketch, photo or reference into manufacturing-ready 3DM and STL files, with a first look within 6 hours of order confirmation for standard pieces, from $35 a design. It works with businesses only, not consumers.

## Key facts

- Service: custom jewelry CAD design and jewelry CAD outsourcing (3D modeling for casting and 3D printing), plus photo-real jewelry rendering and repair of CAD files made by other designers.
- Software: Rhino and MatrixGold, with ZBrush for organic and sculpted pieces.
- Pieces: rings (including engagement rings and wedding bands), pendants, earrings, bracelets, bangles and necklaces.
- Price: from $35 a design, in US dollars. A fixed price within the hour, before you pay. Complex and sculpted pieces are quoted. Retainers for regular orders (monthly rate, named account manager, priority in the queue).
- Renders only: photo-real renders of the client's own 3DM or STL, from $15 a design.
- CAD file repair: inspection, repair and optimization of 3DM and STL files made elsewhere (geometry, non-manifold meshes, structural defects, manufacturing readiness), quoted after the file is reviewed.
- Speed: first look within 6 hours of order confirmation for standard pieces, or the full amount comes back as credit. Complex pieces get a firm deadline with the price.
- Every order includes: 3DM + STL ready for printing and casting; 3 render views; a signed spec sheet (walls, prongs, stone seats, size); a weight sheet in 10K, 14K, 18K, platinum and silver; a 3D preview link with the client's logo; 2 revision rounds within 14 days.
- Quality: every file is checked twice (two-stage QC: the designer's check, then the QC manager's). 99% of first looks meet the brief and the factory's requirements. If a file breaks its own spec sheet, it is fixed free and the CAD fee is refunded (30-day window).
- Team: 50+ senior CAD designers with 10+ years each in production CAD. AI-native workflow: AI does the modeling, experts check every file.
- Accounts: jewelry businesses only. A new account adds its business details and one proof of registration; the team checks it before the portal opens.
- Ownership: white-label, NDA by default; the client owns the files once paid. Designers never see the client's customer.
- Where: studio in Mumbai, India. Serves jewelry businesses in the United States first, and in the UK, Australia and Canada. Orders are briefed, approved and downloaded in an online portal open 24/7; a person answers calls and WhatsApp 5:30 AM – 2:30 PM ET every day.
- Contact: simran@thecadpillar.com · WhatsApp and phone +91 83692 88293 · https://thecadpillar.com/contact

## Who it is for

- Custom and bridal jewelers who want to show a customer a CAD the same day.
- Manufacturers and trade shops with more CAD work than designers (overflow, rush weeks or every order).
- Brands and wholesalers launching new collections.
- Not for consumers looking to buy a finished piece of jewelry.
